rules.numeric_values: MUST use JetBrains Mono or similar monospace font to prevent jitter during live updates.
rules.units: MUST be displayed next to every value (e.g., °C, kg/cm², % vol, mmWC) in secondary text color, slightly smaller.
rules.headings: Semi-condensed sans (Chivo), uppercase for panel titles, tight tracking.

spacing_and_layout.padding: Compact: p-2 or p-3 inside panels. Dense data tables.
spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid borders on panels to separate content, strictly square corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm). NO shadows.
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: w-64 fixed width, collapsed mode optional, purely functional navigation.
spacing_and_layout.header: h-14 fixed height, contains Unit Load MW, Operating Mode ribbon, and Data Quality badge.

components.panels: Flat, background #1E1E1E, 1px border #3F3F46. No drop shadows.
components.buttons: Square or rounded-sm. Outline or ghost by default to reduce visual noise. Solid backgrounds ONLY for active scenarios or critical actions.
components.status_badges: Minimalist. Colored border with colored text on dark background, or small colored dot + text. Do NOT use large solid color blocks unless critical alarm.
components.tables: Dense. text-sm or text-xs. border-b #27272A for rows. Numeric columns right-aligned with monospace font.
components.charts: Recharts. Dark mode grid lines. Remove padding. Tooltips must be dark with monospace values.
components.gauges: Minimalist arc with a clear pointer. Use neutral grey for track, color only for the active value if it hits warning/critical zones, otherwise keep green or neutral.
components.scenario_injector: A fixed panel or dropdown in the header/sidebar for dev/demo purposes to inject 'Normal', 'Excess Air Event', etc.

motion.transitions: Smooth transitions for gauge pointers and trend line updates (e.g., 300ms ease-out).
motion.alarms: Subtle background flash or pulsating border (1Hz) for unacknowledged critical alarms.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against panel background meets 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.color_independence: Status must never be conveyed by color alone. Add text labels (e.g., 'ERR', 'WRN', 'OK') or distinct icons next to colored elements.
accessibility.focus: Visible keyboard focus states (2px ring of primary or white color).

modules.name: Boiler Operating KPI Dashboard
features: Parameter grid with sparklines and zone chips

modules.name: Combustion Excess Air Monitor
features: CO-O2 quadrant plot with fading trail

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="boiler-gauge"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a strict ISA-101 style dark dashboard. Do NOT use default SaaS aesthetics (no soft shadows, no large border radii, no purple/blue gradients).
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the layout frame and custom dense panels.
Build Recharts with strict dark mode configuration: `#27272A` grid lines, `#A1A1AA` text.
For the BOI gauge, use a custom SVG or Recharts radial bar.
Ensure the WebSocket/Polling simulation uses `setInterval` or real FastAPI websockets to stream values.
Implement the 'Inject Scenario' dropdown in the top header or sidebar to change the mocked data parameters.
Use strictly JetBrains Mono or similar monospace font for ALL numbers.
Ensure every data value displays its corresponding engineering unit.
Include `data-testid` on all buttons, tabs, and key metrics.
